facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows of her night visits and is not interested, and she left crestfallen (beat_61, beat_62); Dunk was never released from the deal.

facts.text: Warwick told the party he blames his night visitors on the Clurichen. Does he actually know Ingrid is his night visitor, as Sir Phidipaldi told her?

Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and plays it every night while the party is away, to ward off his night visitors (Ingrid); Sir Phidipaldi claims the Clurichen fear music. This may hinder Dunk helping Ingrid into Warwick's house.
